migration.symlink_reason: serve_map.open_local applies O_NOFOLLOW to every directory and file; use real files or same-filesystem hardlinks during staging, not symlink shims.
migration.live_reloading: MapStore.read/public/asset re-read the manifest for each request. Existing server processes need no restart for path-only edits; browser Refresh reloads manifest and unloads current models.
migration.transition: Stage real destination files first, byte-SHA verify, atomically replace manifests, verify all live asset routes, then remove old runs paths. Keep old paths during transition for in-flight clients. No mutation executed by this audit.
migration.retire_note: Only the four selected live entrypoints are retained. Legacy manifests/test jobs/offline PNG review may have runs/data references; archive/label them historical instead of retaining those trees recursively.

preserved_if_bytes_unchanged: existing screenshot and reference-view JSON hashes
changes: any assembly/report text edited to add relocated paths
hash_impact.historical_evidence: Existing full_preview_v2_viewer.json and capacity/native reports pin pre-relocation manifests/source paths. Preserve originals as historical observations; do not silently rewrite hashes or claim they are post-migration tests.
hash_impact.recommended_new_evidence: Main migration record should map old path -> current path with unchanged PLY SHA/count, before/after manifest hashes and fresh CPU route results.
hash_impact.assembly_policy: Prefer keeping original assembly.json immutable as build provenance; add relocation map/documentation. If updating assembly.sources[].path, archive original bytes first, retain original_path and record both SHA256 values.
